column1: # Golden vectors for pseudonymisation algorithm v1 (HmacSHA256).
# These pin the algorithm. If a change to the generator makes this file
# fail, that is the file doing its job: every synthetic identity already
# issued under v1 would have changed. Do not re-bless it. Ship a v2 and
# leave v1 resolvable, per docs/design-review.md B4.
